name: Binbin!! ~Kare to Kanojo to Binbou na Kami-sama~
original_name: びんビンッ!! ～彼と彼女と貧乏な神様～
source:
The family shrine was in total disrepair.
Really falling apart. Chunks falling off.

A young girl popped out from the wreckage.
She introduced herself as poverty goddess.

"Fix my home!"

Sure, the protagonist would love to, but until then...
It seems they'll live together in a world of ruin.
Poor, poor moneyless life! ADV game

Let's raise the curtain and begin our story. 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE071934.html]DLsite English[/url]]
